tool.name: RemoveRegional
tool.summary: Remove a regional trend: fits a 1st-order (plane) or 2nd-order polynomial surface to the valid cells by least squares and subtracts it.
tool.usage: Fitted in the space domain, so the FFT buffer is not used.

param.name: in_raster
param.dialogReference: Grid to process (a single-band raster; no-data cells are left as no-data in the result).
param.pythonReference: Grid to process (a single-band raster; no-data cells are left as no-data in the result).

param.name: out_raster
param.dialogReference: Output raster (GeoTIFF), with the input's extent, cell size and coordinate system.
param.pythonReference: Output raster (GeoTIFF), with the input's extent, cell size and coordinate system.

param.name: order
param.dialogReference: 1st Order: a plane. 2nd Order: a quadratic surface.
param.pythonReference: 1st Order: a plane. 2nd Order: a quadratic surface.

param.name: buffer_size
param.dialogReference: Not used by this tool (the fit is in the space domain).
param.pythonReference: Not used by this tool (the fit is in the space domain).
